evals.name: provider-repeat
evals.prompt: The same unchanged directory author arrives on consecutive polls. Model the contract.
evals.expected_output: A keyed Translate capture and repeated-input example.
assertions: Appends a local fact on addition.
Expects no new event on the unchanged repeat.

evals.name: clock
evals.prompt: An author reminder is due at a scheduled instant. Delineate the model and runtime checks.
evals.expected_output: A clock-driven automation decision with a fixed clock.
assertions: Chooses a reaction rather than an editor command.
Supplies an explicit instant and prior state.
Does not infer real scheduler reliability from the model.

evals.name: key-reuse
evals.prompt: Our vendor reuses deleted author IDs. Can we promise import deduplication?
assertions: Distinguishes replay from a new author.
Requests evidence distinguishing generations of the key.
Separates provider behavior from local model guarantees.
